headline: Divided Fronts Register Fresh Base Fighting
war_summary: The latest ledger records a renewed burst of strategic-base movement across the divided fronts. Stlican Shelf leads with 58 events in 24 hours, including eight in the latest two-hour window, while its nine bases stand six Warden to three Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains heavily engaged at 57 daily events and three in two hours, with the same six-to-three split. Godcrofts has risen to 28 daily events and nine in the latest two hours, though its current holdings are entirely Colonial. Fisherman’s Row posts 18 events, three of them in the latest two hours, and is divided six Colonial to three Warden. Linn Mercy has logged 21 daily events, two recently, with ten Colonial bases and one standing neutral. Callahan’s Passage, quiet in the earlier edition, now reports two events in two hours and 15 across the day; nine bases are Warden-held and one remains neutral. Stonecradle retains 27 daily events and eight in six hours but none in the latest two. Casualty rates are accelerating on several of these fronts, notably Weathered Expanse, Callahan’s Passage and Stonecradle, marking them as the principal watch points for the next report.
